Locked in a stifling deliberation room on a blistering summer afternoon, twelve jurors must decide the fate of a young man accused of patricide. What initially seems like an open-and-shut case quickly unravels as one lone dissenter introduces reasonable doubt, sparking intense psychological clashes and exposing deep-seated prejudices. As tempers flare and personal biases come to light, the men are forced to confront not only the evidence at hand, but the very nature of justice itself.
